title: Quantum Leap (QL)

body:
Quantum Leap introduces cutting-edge quantum technology into Minecraft, giving players the power to explore the limits of science and imagination. Craft powerful quantum devices to teleport instantly across vast distances, duplicate rare materials through molecular reconstruction, and experiment with unstable energy fields that can bend time and space.

Discover new resources like Quantum Crystals, Entangled Matter, and Fluxium, which fuel your technological advancements. Build Quantum Cores, Teleportation Gates, and Chrono Stabilizers to expand your base or traverse the multiverse.

But beware — tampering with quantum forces can have unpredictable consequences. Misaligned experiments might tear rifts in space, spawn anomalies, or even trap you in alternate timelines.

Do you have what it takes to master the quantum realm?
